name: Mingodale Farm
tagline: Link to Mingodale Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/Mingodale
description: A working pumpkin patch in 201 Masemore Road, MD, Mingodale Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
